title: Relative independence of the separable quotient problem

abstractEnglish: The separable quotient problem asks whether every infinite-dimensional Banach space has a separable infinite-dimensional quotient. We prove that this statement is independent of ZFC, relative to the consistency of ZFC with a measurable cardinal. This holds over both the real and complex fields. For spaces of norm density ℵ1, we obtain independence relative to the consistency of ZFC alone.
titleEn: Relative independence of the separable quotient problem
titleZh: 可分商问题的相对独立性

details.overview: 可分商问题问是否每个无限维Banach空间都有可分无限维商空间。稿件摘要称，在ZFC与可测基数一致的前提下，该命题独立于ZFC；实域与复域情形均如此。对于范数密度为ℵ₁的空间，作者声称仅需ZFC的一致性即可得到独立性。研究属于泛函分析与集合论交叉领域，材料仅见摘要，未展开力迫构造或证明。
keyPoints: 声称可分商问题相对ZFC独立，需可测基数一致性。
实域与复域情形均适用。
范数密度ℵ₁空间仅需ZFC一致性。
